annotations.title: Look up a b/cited glossary term

description: Define a term the way b/cited's glossary defines it — AEO, citation, brand rank, visibility score, authority score, topical cluster, coverage diff, llms.txt, ai.txt, and 30 more. Matches on term, alias, or slug, and returns the best match plus close alternatives. With no term, returns every entry.

term.description: The term, alias, or slug to look up. Omit to list all entries.
